name: Food Freshness sensor IoT device
desc: This project focuses on an IoT-based food freshness monitoring system that uses real-time sensors inside fridges and storage units to track spoilage indicators. It analyzes temperature, humidity, and gas emissions to estimate remaining shelf life accurately. The system then alerts users when items should be consumed, cooked, or discounted, helping reduce waste and improve sustainability in both homes and retail environments.

name: Pest Prediction Sensor
desc: A network of tiny field sensors plus satellite data that predicts pest outbreaks before they hit the crops. The system monitors humidity, leaf wetness, soil warmth, wind patterns, and plant stress signals, then compares them with known pest behavior models. When conditions match a likely infestation window, farmers get an alert with the specific pest risk, the affected zone, and the safest intervention options.
